hero_title: Safalta Ki Or Aapki Drive Ko Saral Banate Hue
hero_description: Hamara streamlined platform drivers ke liye un sabhi services tak pahunchna aasan banata hai jinki unhe zaroorat hai. Registration se lekar parinaam prapt karne tak, har kadam aapko dhyaan mein rakhkar design kiya gaya hai.
video_card_description: Hamare platform ko action mein dekhein
video_subtext: 3 min ka overview • Signup ki zaroorat nahi
grid_title: Hamara Platform Kaise Kaam Karta Hai
grid_description: Bharat Sarathi ke sabhi fayde unlock karne ke liye in aasan kadmon ka paalan karein.

steps_list.title: Aasani se Sign Up Karein
steps_list.description: Apni बुनियादी details ke saath register karein aur kuch hi minute mein shuru ho jayein.

steps_list.title: Avsaron Ko Explore Karein
steps_list.description: Naukriyon, insurance vikalpon, loan suvidhaon, aur bhi bahut kuch tak pahunchein—sab ek hi jagah.

steps_list.title: Judein Aur Aage Badhein
steps_list.description: Ek aise समुदाय se judein jo aapke peshewar aur vyaktigat vikas ka samarthan karta hai.

steps_list.title: Soochit Rahein
steps_list.description: Traffic niyam, challan samadhan, aur driver kalyan yojnaon par updates prapt karein.
